meta.name: business-name-fit
meta.description: Suggest, pick, or vet a business, startup, or product name that stays true to the founder's cultural origin while working professionally in the markets they want to sell into. Use when someone is naming a company, brand, or product and cares about how it lands across languages and regions — for example a name that sounds right at home but might read oddly to English speakers, or an authentic name they want to check before committing. Trigger this for any request about choosing a business name, checking if a name "works" abroad, spotting bad meanings in other languages, or making a name sound trustworthy in a specific market — even if the person doesn't say the word "skill".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为公司挑选跨文化不出错的品牌名
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在为创业公司起名,担心名字在国外有歧义。
copy.tagline_en: Pick a brand name that works across cultures and markets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're naming a startup and want it to sound professional everywhere.

howto.what: 帮用户起名或审查已有的公司、品牌、产品名,检查名字在目标市场的含义、发音、拼写等是否合适,并以紧凑表格给出3-5个候选或每个名字的审查结果,最后列出还需人工核实的商标、域名等事项。
howto.when: 当用户提出给公司、品牌或产品起名,或想检查某个名字在海外/其他语言中的含义与听感时触发。典型场景:起新名字、验证已有名字在外国市场是否合适、排查名字在其他语言里的负面含义等。

say.text: 我想给一家波斯背景的儿童托育公司起名,目标市场是美国,帮我出几个候选。
say.note: 会先问模式,然后收集信息并给出候选表。

say.text: 我有个名字“Anali”,帮我查查它在英语市场和伊朗分别怎么样。
say.note: 会运行含义、发音、拼写等检查并给结论。

say.text: 这家法务公司是瑞典的,名字叫“Framat”,在欧盟市场会不会有歧义?
say.note: 会做逐项适配检查并给出简表。

howto.what_en: Helps users create or vet business/brand/product names, checking meaning, pronunciation, spelling, and tone in target markets, then presents 3–5 candidates or verdicts in a compact table, and lists verification steps like trademark and domain checks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to name a company, brand, or product, or wants to check how a name lands abroad—looking for bad meanings, pronunciation issues, or trustworthiness in a specific market.

say_en.text: I need a name for a Persian-origin childcare company targeting the US. Give me candidates.
say_en.note: It will ask for mode, gather details, and present a shortlist.

say_en.text: Check the name 'Anali'—how does it work in English-speaking markets and in Iran?
say_en.note: It will run meaning, pronunciation, spelling checks and give a verdict.

say_en.text: This Swedish law firm is named 'Framat'. Any issues in the EU market?
say_en.note: It will run fit checks and return a compact table.
